d.t: Textured High Build Durable 100% Solids Pigmented Non Blooming Epoxy Coating
d.s: Sikafloor-264 T AU is a thixotropic, textured 2- componant solvent free pigmented 100% solids high build epoxy coating for durable, decorative finishes. It can be appied to vertical surfaces in addition to providing durable floor surface.
a: Excellent resistance to whiteneing / blooming from early exposure to surface moisture
Can be applied on vertical and horizontal surfaces
Very good chemical resistance (Refer to Sika Chem. resistance data)
us: Sikafloor-264 T AU can be used in a variety of Industrial and commercial applications;

Levelling : Rough surface profiles may need to be levelled first to ensure a high quality even finish. Sikafloor 160 combined with silica fillers. The grade and filler content can be altered to accommodate the depth of profile to be filled. Refer to Sikafloor 160 TDS for guideance. Mixing: Add pigment pack to the part A and mix to blend in. Add the Part B and mix the full kit for a minimum of 2 minutes. Application: Apply product using a medium to long knap roller (15-20mm) with a central pole double frame arrangement. Apply evenly at the prescribed coverage rate then "lay off " in the opposite direction of rolling for optimum results. Final layoff technique - take the weight of the roller and lift the roller from the surface when completing to lay off stroke. Not adopting the technique and or not having sufficient manpower to execute this proceedure will likely result in uneven appearance.
Sikafloor-264 T AU must be thorougly mixed using a low speed stirrer (300 - 400 rpm)

Placing the kits at an even rate of pot life and joining up wet edges progressively within even time frames is critical for optimum results. If this is not adhered to then differing colour shades will result when the product has reached touch dry stage.
Clean all tools immediately after use Thinner C. Hardened and/or cured material can only be removed mechanically.

Sikafloor-264 T AU should be kept as clean as possible to maximise durability and reduce abrasion. Good housekeeping practices should be followed when Chemical spills occur. Clean with neutral based, non solvent based cleaning chemicals. - Refer to Sikafloor Cleaning Guidelines document for more details.
